steps.title: Open the booking
steps.body: From My bookings (customer) or the confirmation / lookup (guest).
steps.expect: Trip with each flight's status, travellers and tickets, contact, payment, documents, history. Buttons only for `canModifyContacts`, `canCancel`, `canRefresh`, `canDownloadDocuments`.

steps.title: Change contact details
steps.body: Change contact details → new e-mail and mobile → Save.
steps.expect: Dialog closes and says where the confirmation went. DB: `booking_contacts` replaced, `bookings.contact_email` and `version` + 1, `booking_events` `booking.contacts_updated`. Mailpit: "Your booking <ref> with Demo Travel has been updated" to the new address and "The contact details of booking <ref> … were changed" to the old one.

steps.title: Cancel with the refund preview
steps.body: Cancel booking → read the mode and refund → choose a reason → Confirm.
steps.expect: "This booking is cancelled" with the date in the OTA's time zone; the trip moves to the Cancelled tab. DB: `bookings.status = 'cancelled'`, `cancelled_by = 'customer'`, a `refunds` row or a voided authorisation; Redis `t:<tenantId>:test:cxq:<bookingId>` used. Mailpit: "Your booking <ref> is cancelled".

steps.title: Documents and fare rules
steps.body: Download a ready document; open **Changes and refunds**; press **Refresh from airline**.
steps.expect: Each click asks a fresh signed URL (`/api/v1/files/…?exp=…&sig=…`, 5 minutes). A booking synced < 60 s ago answers the fare rules with `429`: "The fare rules will be available in about a minute". Refresh is throttled to once a minute.
